name: Stability Image
author: hearth-team
description: Image generation via Stability AI — Stable Diffusion 3, Stable Image Core, Ultra. Strong photorealism and prompt adherence; inpaint + outpaint + upscale endpoints under one key. Pass `model` to pick a tier (default core). Single prompt → image saved to /dashboard/collateral.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

vault_inputs.label: Stability AI API Key
vault_inputs.help: From platform.stability.ai → Account → API keys. Starts with sk-… . Stored encrypted.
